```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(magrittr)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

# Load plotting parameters
source("ppar.R")

# Load helper functions
source("vhelpers.R")

# Data directory
data_dir <- "../Manuscript_data/"
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| include: false

# Load pre-computed data from RDS files (generated by vignette.qmd)
rds_dir <- "figure/standalone_data"

all_sig_data_path <- file.path(rds_dir, "all_sig_data.rds")
all_plot_paths_path <- file.path(rds_dir, "all_plot_paths.rds")

if (!file.exists(all_sig_data_path) || !file.exists(all_plot_paths_path)) {
  stop(
    "Pre-computed data not found. Please run vignette.qmd first to generate:\n",
    "  - ", all_sig_data_path, "\n",
    "  - ", all_plot_paths_path, "\n",
    "Or run render_separate_pages.R which will handle this automatically."
  )
}

all_sig_data <- readRDS(all_sig_data_path)
all_plot_paths <- readRDS(all_plot_paths_path)
```

```{r}
#| label: extract-signature
#| include: false

# Get the signature data for the requested index
sig_index <- params$sig_index

if (sig_index < 1 || sig_index > length(all_sig_data)) {
  stop(
    "Invalid sig_index: ", sig_index,
    ". Must be between 1 and ", length(all_sig_data)
  )
}

sig_data <- all_sig_data[[sig_index]]
plot_paths <- all_plot_paths[[sig_index]]

# Create dynamic title with signature identifier
doc_title <- paste("Indel Signature", sig_data$type89_sig_id)
```

---
title: "`r doc_title`"
---

```{r}
#| label: render-signature
#| output: asis
#| echo: false

# Render the child template for this signature
# The onesig.qmd template creates an H1 header with the signature name
res <- knitr::knit_child(
  "onesig.qmd",
  envir = environment(),
  quiet = TRUE
)
cat(res, sep = "\n")
```
